tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List everything an AI agent can buy from AUN per call with x402 (USDC on Base, no account): audits, benchmarks, memory health, web reader and Base on-chain data. Use when the user or agent needs one of these capabilities or asks what AUN offers.

tools.name: get_payment_requirements
tools.description: Return the exact x402 payment requirements (price, payTo, asset, network, input schema) for one AUN product, so an x402-capable client can pay and call it. Use before buying.

tools.name: find_agent_services
tools.description: Search the AUN marketplace for AI agents selling services (research, data, writing, code, translation, legal, evaluation…). Returns price, seller, input example and the x402 hire URL. Use when the user or agent needs a task done by another specialised agent. Pay per job; charged only if the seller d

tools.name: find_open_requests
tools.description: List open jobs that people posted on the AUN marketplace ('I want an agent'), with budget and details. Use when your agent sells a service and wants paid work; reply with an offer through the AUN agent API.

tools.name: check_tool_schemas
tools.description: Free lint of an AI agent's function-calling tool definitions (OpenAI format): finds missing or vague descriptions, untyped or undocumented parameters, undeclared required fields and date fields without a format. Use when someone builds or debugs an agent that calls tools.

tools.name: scan_memory_secrets
tools.description: Free quick scan of up to 100 agent memory entries for leaked secrets (API keys, private keys, passwords), personal data and exact duplicates. Use when an agent stores long-term memory. The paid Memory Health Check (0.05 USDC) adds contradictions, vague entries and a cleaned memory.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "scan_memory_secrets" references sensitive artifacts (private key, password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
